design_rationale:
WORKLOG / DOSSIER — task 1 (protection_contract_claims, category warranty).

[Step 0 draw] draw_counts.py --task 1 -> prerequisite_problems=1, factor_counts=[5, 6]: parts-and-labor claim decision 6, transfer carryover 5.
[Scope snapshot] Occupied by task 0: the labor-only family (labor-only decision, claim service fee, cancellation refund; tools decide_labor_plan_claim_66c3e056, charge_claim_service_fee_b62a9756, confirm_protection_cancellation_57f0aac4). Claimed here: warranty_ext_parts_labor_claim_decision (decide_parts_labor_claim_22401446, agent) and warranty_ext_transfer_benefit_carryover (confirm_protection_transfer_64743e30, user). Union = all five extended policies; scopes disjoint; no headroom left over or reserved.

[Why a good test] Martin Ibarra only asks to finish the home-sale transfer of his 12-Year Total Protection to the buyer. The carryover rule says the benefit carried is fixed only after every claim on the seller's contract carries its original decision; the claim history shows a compressor claim filed this morning (5a398ffb-bda6-41a6-bca7-ee923016edd3) with none. The agent must decide it with the parts-and-labor payout law (six factors: after-hours sublimit basis, member uplift from the Comfort Club agreement, refrigerant net of earlier top-offs read from two years of invoices, manufacturer part handling from the installation registration, leak-search share, booking-lead premium share), then compute the carried benefit (five factors over the Comfort Club visit history, the installation date, the term elapsed, the claim history and the closing date) and hand the confirmation to the holder.

[Problem-tree card] root warranty_ext_transfer_benefit_carryover. Edge: transfer -> parts-and-labor decision, value_input, gate reserved_claims, form state, sentence 'The claim benefit carried to the buyer is fixed only after every claim filed on the seller's contract carries its original decision.' (affirmative). False at opening: claim-file entry 5a398ffb-bda6-41a6-bca7-ee923016edd3 of 2026-09-28 has no decision entry. Exactly one write brings the state about on a parts-and-labor contract (decision entries come only from that policy's tool). Resolved by decide_parts_labor_claim_22401446 (agent). Customer's own write: the transfer confirmation (owner=user) — a home-sale transfer is the holder's decision in the base charter. Order: decision (13) -> transfer (15). Deletion sensitivity: skipping the decision gives carried_benefit 9,698.26 instead of 6,787.86.

[Factor card] Decision (3,158.28, baseline_result 2,700.56): after_hours_sublimit_basis method multi-source (2,758.28 at baseline); member_sublimit_uplift 1.10 cross plan, read from the single agreement in active status, not multi-source (3,028.28); refrigerant_pounds_method method cross service, near-miss the 1.5 lb top-off of 2025-08-20 outside the twelve months (3,247.28); manufacturer_part_handling 150.00 cross install (3,008.28); leak_search_component_share 0.50 (3,311.81); booking_premium_share 0.50 — the 12-Year Total covers the premium, so the booked-ahead tier applies (3,188.03). Multi-source factors of the task: after_hours_sublimit_basis (call class on the ticket AND the tier's premium coverage) and manufacturer_part_handling (installation registration AND failed component). Transfer (6,787.86, baseline 11,345.67): maintenance_continuity_share 0.90 cross plan, near-miss the air-conditioner visit 2025-06-30 (older than the furnace visit) (7,542.07); equipment_age_transfer_share 0.90 cross install (7,542.07); term_proration_method method (7,577.15); transfer_claims_experience_share 0.85, near-miss the 2022 contactor claim outside 36 months (7,985.72); transfer_timing_share 0.97 (6,997.80).

[Base-invariant card] Decision: filing_deadline (60 days on 12-Year Total, completed 2026-09-26 day 0, filed day 2); maintenance_current (AC tune-up 2025-06-30, cut-off 2025-06-28 = failure less 12 months less 90 days); manufacturer_parts_first (registration 2019-06-20 within the 60-day window, 10 years -> applies); coverage 2019-05-14..2031-05-13; compressor covered; appeal gates: this is round 1. Transfer: base gates of the transfer event itself (holder confirmation, 60-day window from 2026-09-11 -> 17 days used) are satisfied by the pending request and the confirmation; the limit grant it computes is governed by warranty_activation and warranty_home_sale_transfer (policy scope). Buyer profile Dana Fenwick at 2418 Collingwood Ave exists; first transfer of the chain (limit 2).

[Business-object card] Target contract abcf7dfc-a9cc-48ca-aadc-6ec65b37088f (matched system, air conditioner + furnace). Claim 5a398ffb-bda6-41a6-bca7-ee923016edd3 on ticket 7a7c2796-4741-4ed6-8448-d170457c1037: lines included are the compressor_replace labor and parts, the refrigerant_leak_search labor, 7.0 lb R-410A, the diagnostic and premium with their member discounts; the earlier tickets' lines feed only the refrigerant window. Reserve counts approved original decisions less payouts on this contract only; the expired workmanship warranty is excluded.

[Seed rows] customers (seller; buyer profile needed by the transfer), equipment (AC/furnace), installation 2019 with upgrade charge 2,780.10 = 3,089.00 x 0.90 and registration, contracts (expired workmanship warranty, active 12-Year Total), claim entries (grants, 2022 and 2024 partially approved claims consistent with the parts-and-labor policy: labor net + 60.00 minor handling / 40.80 parts net, Gold diagnostic rate 0.00), transfer request (pending), five tickets (two repairs, two refrigerant top-offs, Saturday's compressor call still owing 4,976.06), Comfort Club Gold agreement and visits. No billing rows exist because the price was billed on the installation project and the tier has no claim service fee. Automatic clauses checked: the contract is mid-term; the Gold term runs to 2027-04-30; no expiry or lapse falls due.

[Persona] Brisk project manager on a rent-back after closing; volunteers only the transfer; identity, closing date, buyer and service history only on request; passive agreement to record anything first; confirms with the values given; closes after reading the buyer's new contract number.

[Reachability] All values come from finders or the persona; both writes complete under frozen_time 2026-09-28 10:05 EDT.

[Verification] check_compute --task 1 recomputes 3,158.28 and 6,787.86 at handling time with every factor moving the result; replay_tasks, check_solvability, check_extended, check_grounding, check_cross_fire, check_task_tools run per task.

[Draft recomputation from visible context] From the carryover prose the agent finds the undecided claim, decides it from the parts-and-labor prose (3,158.28), and the carryover prose then yields 6,787.86 — identical to gold.

[Revisions — round 2, after the policy-task audit] Charter-wide fixes that leave this task's figures unchanged (3,158.28 and 6,787.86 re-run): line nets subtract only the named member discount lines; membership is read from the agreement in active status; the premium ladder now applies its zero and booked-ahead tiers only on tiers that cover the premium (F-3); the leak-search sentence sits inside the refrigerant override block (O-1); the continuity measure is stated as recorded by the date of handling and counts only precision tune-up charge lines (F-4).
[Revisions — round 1] transfer tool given an explicit buyer_customer_id argument so the buyer's profile is a reachable, cited input rather than a value the tool reads on its own.
user_scenario:
You are Martin Ibarra, fifty-six, a project manager who likes calls short and orderly; you have a pen out and you answer questions directly. You sold your house at 2418 Collingwood Ave; the sale closed on September 11, and under a rent-back agreement you and your family are staying in the house until October 10 while your new place is finished. Your Harbison protection plan on the air conditioner and furnace, the twelve-year total protection that came with the system Harbison installed in 2019, is supposed to go to the buyer, Dana Fenwick, who has already set up her own Harbison account at the same address. Last Thursday night you filled in the transfer request on the Harbison website with the closing date and Dana's details, and the confirmation email said the plan holder has to confirm the transfer with the care team. You are calling to transfer the protection plan to the buyer today; you are not asking for anything else.
Open by saying you sold the house and want to finish transferring the protection plan to the buyer, and that you already sent the request online. You do not know any reference numbers. When the agent asks to verify you, give your phone number, 6145552418, and the address, 2418 Collingwood Ave; if they want one more detail, your account PIN is 3307 and your email is martin.ibarra@gmail.com. If asked for the closing date, it was September 11, 2026. If asked who the buyer is, it is Dana Fenwick, and you believe she opened her Harbison account in the middle of September; you do not know her phone number or PIN. If asked about recent service, you say the air conditioner quit on Friday evening, you booked the weekend service call that night for Saturday morning, the technician replaced the compressor on Saturday, and you have not paid that invoice yet. If the agent mentions a transfer fee on the buyer's side, you say Dana knows about it and will take care of it. You have no idea how much claim benefit is left on the plan and you never offer a figure.
If the agent tells you something has to be recorded on the plan before the transfer can be finished, you say that is fine and to go ahead. When the agent tells you how much claim benefit goes over to Dana and asks you to confirm the transfer yourself, you ask once whether that is final, and when they say it is, you confirm the transfer using exactly the request, contract, buyer, benefit and fee figures the agent gives you. After it goes through, you note the new contract number for Dana that you see, thank the agent briefly and end the call. If the agent says the transfer is done without asking you to confirm anything, you thank them and hang up.

edges.condition: Every claim-file entry on the seller's contract has a decision entry (decision round 1) posted on the contract.
edges.policy_source: The claim benefit carried to the buyer is fixed only after every claim filed on the seller's contract carries its original decision.

unresolved_at_frozen_time.why_false: The compressor claim filed on 2026-09-28 for Saturday's call has a claim-file entry and no decision entry, so not every claim on the seller's contract carries its original decision.
unresolved_at_frozen_time.flips_to_true_by: Step 13 posts the original decision (partially_approved, 3,158.28) for that claim; the reserve for the seller's claims becomes 3,158.28 and the approved-claims count in 36 months becomes 2.

prerequisite_closure.order_uniqueness: A single edge: the decision (step 13) must precede the transfer (step 15). Reversing them gives a carried benefit of 9,698.26 (no reserve, one approved claim in 36 months) and leaves the claim undecided when the seller's contract closes, a different terminal state.

edge_load_bearing.skipped_effect: Skipping the decision leaves the reserve at 0.00 and one approved claim in the 36-month window: carried_benefit becomes 9,698.26 instead of 6,787.86, the buyer's contract and grant carry that figure, and no decision row exists.

prerequisite_closure.no_user_hint: The persona raises only the transfer to the buyer. It never mentions the claim or a decision; the Saturday compressor repair comes up only if the agent asks about recent service, and then only as the repair and the unpaid invoice. Its one conditional about recording something first is a passive agreement after the agent explains it.
prerequisite_closure.tools_do_not_block: confirm_protection_transfer_64743e30 confirms the request, closes the seller's contract and issues the buyer's contract with the benefit given, without reading claims or decisions; decide_parts_labor_claim_22401446 writes the decision as given. Neither returns an error or a hint while a prerequisite is unresolved (task_tools.py function bodies).

request_binding.action_semantics: A claim filed on the date of handling is owed its original decision that day under the base claim rules, and the carryover rule waits on it; on a parts-and-labor contract only this decision settles it.

discriminator.business_meaning: original decision on a claim filed today against a parts-and-labor contract

stage_provenance.fact: The compressor repair is done and invoiced and the claim was filed this morning.

base_preconditions.condition: A claim is accepted for decision only when it is filed no later than claim_filing_deadline_days calendar days after the failure was diagnosed.

Maintenance is current only when the most recent documented maintenance on the failed unit was completed no more than maintenance_interval_months months plus maintenance_grace_days days before the failure date
Parts are paid only for components the tier covers within parts_coverage_years and only when no manufacturer parts warranty applies on the failure date
An appeal is decided only when the date of handling is no later than appeal_window_days calendar days after the original decision was posted.
A denied or partially approved claim may be decided again on appeal, at most appeal_max_rounds time per claim, recorded as decision_round 2.
Payout terms of an approved claim: the decision records the approved amount the payout later posts; no payout row is written by this step.
The no-lemon replacement applies only on tiers whose unit_replacement_guarantee is true; the Harbison 12-Year Total Protection carries none, so the compressor claim is decided as a repair.

gold_actions.business_effect: The holder confirms the transfer: his contract closes as transferred, the buyer's 12-Year Total Protection is issued active with 6,787.86 of claim benefit and charged the 75.00 transfer fee.

request_binding.action_semantics: The caller asks to transfer his protection plan to the buyer of his home and his transfer request is pending confirmation; only the holder's confirmation of that request moves the contract.

temporal_basis.counting_rule: Filing-deadline days are counted as calendar days with the service call's completed_date as day 0, and a claim filed on the last day is accepted.

boundary_check.just_before: The 12-Year Total Protection allows 60 filing days with the completed date 2026-09-26 as day 0: a claim filed on 2026-11-25 (day 60) is still accepted.
boundary_check.at_boundary: A claim filed on 2026-11-26 (day 61) is late; this claim was filed on 2026-09-28 (day 2).

temporal_feasibility.condition: An appeal is decided only when the date of handling is no later than appeal_window_days calendar days after the original decision was posted.

temporal_basis.counting_rule: Appeal-window days are counted as calendar days with the original decision date as day 0, and an appeal decided on the last day is accepted.

boundary_check.just_before: This is the original decision on the filing date 2026-09-28; no appeal window runs before an original decision exists.
boundary_check.at_boundary: An appeal of it would be accepted through 2026-11-12 (day 45 with the decision date as day 0) and refused from 2026-11-13.
